days.title: Northern Wilderness and Lakes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Pyhäkerö-Tagestour
stops.detail: Popular day hikes include, for example, the Pyhäkerö day tour, the Taivaskero circular trail, the Pirunkurun ponnistus, the Varkaankuru path, the Kesänkijärvi circular trail, and the Tuomikuru circular trail.

stops.name: Hetta-Pallas-Wanderweg
stops.detail: Among the most famous hiking trails in the national park is the Hetta-Pallas hiking trail, the oldest marked hiking route in Finland.

stops.name: Pyhäkero
stops.detail: Other high peaks are, for example, the Pyhäkero, Lumikero, Laukukero, and Palkaskero.

stops.name: Pallasjärvi
stops.detail: The largest lake in the park is Lake Pallasjärvi, which lies southeast of the Pallastunturi Nature Centre.

stops.name: Sammaltunturi
stops.detail: In the national park, air purity is constantly measured at the Sammaltunturi weather station.

stops.name: Yllästunturi-Naturzentrum Kellokas
stops.detail: In the Pallas-Yllästunturi National Park, there are three nature centers: the Yllästunturi Nature Centre Kellokas, the Pallastunturi Nature Centre, and the Tunturi-Lappi Nature Centre in Hetta.
